description: Source code for the TrieBitBuffer class, implementing bit buffer operations for Huffman encoding in the net::huffman_trie namespace.

classes.name: TrieBitBuffer
classes.description: A class managing a buffer of bits for Huffman encoding, supporting writing bits, positions, characters, and sizes.

methods.name: WriteBit
methods.description: Writes a single bit to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteBits
methods.description: Writes multiple bits to the buffer.

methods.name: WritePosition
methods.description: Encodes a position delta relative to last position.

methods.name: WriteChar
methods.description: Encodes a character using a Huffman table.

methods.name: WriteSize
methods.description: Encodes a size value with variable-length encoding.

methods.name: AppendBitsElement
methods.description: Appends the current bits as an element to the buffer.

methods.name: AppendPositionElement
methods.description: Appends a position element to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteToBitWriter
methods.description: Flushes buffer and writes all elements to a BitWriter.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the current bits buffer into the elements list.
